title: One Voice
lyrics:
We are one voice, from the first whistle to the last,
Standing together, we won't sit, we won't rest,
Through the rain, through the cold, we're always here,
Our crew, our colors, year after year.

title: Never Alone
lyrics:
You'll never walk this ground alone,
We travel far to call it home,
Every corner, every stand,
Our crew is here, hand in hand.

title: Ninety Minutes
lyrics:
Ninety minutes, on our feet,
Drums are pounding, hear the beat,
We don't stop when the score's not right,
We're here for the badge, we're here for the fight.

title: Away Day
lyrics:
Loaded up before the sun,
Miles of road until it's done,
We don't care how far we roam,
Any stand we stand feels like home.

title: The North Stand Sings
lyrics:
The north stand sings, the north stand roars,
Every matchday, we settle scores,
Flags are flying, smoke in the air,
This is our house, and we'll always be there.

title: Old Colors
lyrics:
Same old colors, same old song,
We've been singing it all along,
Grandfathers taught it, we'll pass it on,
Our crew's chant will never be gone.

title: Heartbeat of the Stand
lyrics:
Listen close, you'll hear it clear,
The heartbeat of the stand is here,
Drums and voices, one and the same,
We are the crew that carries the flame.

title: Till the End
lyrics:
Win or lose, we're still here,
Singing loud without the fear,
Till the final whistle blows,
Till the end, that's how it goes.

title: Flags Held High
lyrics:
Flags held high above the crowd,
Our crew's name sung out loud,
Colors waving in the breeze,
We stand for more than victories.

title: Matchday Morning
lyrics:
Matchday morning, hearts beat fast,
Meeting up like seasons past,
Scarves around us, ready to go,
Off to give the stand a show.

title: First and Last
lyrics:
First to arrive, last to leave,
That's the promise our crew keeps,
Through the highs and through the lows,
Our voice is the one that never goes.

title: Carry the Noise
lyrics:
Carry the noise from the first minute in,
Don't let it fade, don't let it thin,
We are the sound that fills the ground,
Our crew's the loudest noise around.
